code: # The following function simulates remote data in temporary directory, to # enable package usage without downloading. Do not run for normal usage. generate_pkgmatch_example_data ()  input <- "curl" # Name of a single installed package p <- pkgmatch_similar_pkgs (input, corpus = "cran") p # Default print method, lists 5 best matching packages #> [1] "httr"       "AmpGram"    "CancerGram" "crul"       "curl"       head (p) # Shows first 5 rows of full `data.frame` object #>      package version rank #> 1       httr   1.4.7    1 #> 2    AmpGram     1.0    2 #> 3 CancerGram   1.0.0    3 #> 4       crul   1.5.0    4 #> 5       curl   6.2.2    5
